# Literacy Worldwide

> Global advocacy organization connecting 300,000+ educators with research-based literacy resources, professional development, and advocacy for equitable reading access.

The International Literacy Association (ILA) is the world's premier organization dedicated to advancing literacy education and practice. Through its comprehensive digital platform, ILA provides educators with learning resources, professional development opportunities, and community engagement channels to improve literacy outcomes worldwide.

## Key Topics

- International Literacy Association
- Literacy Learning Library
- Professional Development
- Literacy Advocacy
- Teacher Resources
- Digital Events & Webinars
- Literacy Today Magazine
- Children's Rights to Read
- Membership
- Literacy Training
- Governance & Leadership
- Diversifying the Literacy Workforce
- Reading.org
- Literacy Glossary
- On-Demand Courses

- [Governance](https://www.literacyworldwide.org/about-us/governance): ILA governance structure and 12-person Board of Directors overview
